title: ASX MAXIMUM EDGE V8-I Data Gateway V3.4.3.2 Acceptance Specification
design_goal: Prove timestamped single-symbol REST integrity and measure real WebSocket streaming quality without consuming Free-plan REST quota.

tier_1_rest.name: Single-symbol timestamp repeatability
pass_conditions: all observations contain source timestamp t
tier_1_rest.note: Timestamp repeatability can pass while live freshness fails. Do not alter thresholds to force promotion.

statuses.FRESH_STREAM: At least one GREEN event and advancing source timestamps observed.
statuses.FRESH_EVENT: GREEN event observed but timestamp progression not yet proven.
statuses.STALE_STREAM: Events observed but no GREEN event observed.
statuses.NO_EVENT: No market-data event observed; not treated as stale.

pass_conditions: at least one market-data event received
at least one GREEN event received
at least one advancing source-timestamp pair observed
hard_rules: gateway latency is not market-data age
do not borrow quote timestamps for depth

breadth.note: Run separately from REST Tier-1 on the Free plan.

batch.failure_policy: Classify as unavailable/restricted; do not treat it as failure of the single-symbol feed.

execution.rule: Data integrity never grants trading execution authorization.
